periods.name: 孟买港伊·U与诺契勒斯会合
periods.summary: I-U surfaces behind Nautilus in Mumbai Bay, checkmates it, then signals non-hostility. Sherlock crosses by ice bridge and proposes the reunion/alliance and WATSON mission.
periods.outcome: I-U and Nautilus avoid battle; Sherlock invites Nautilus leaders to the second I-U reunion.
